parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss (UTC).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:
- 30 (default)
- 50
- 100

parameters.name: QueryDurationMs
parameters.description: The execution duration of the slow SQL statement. The minimum value is **1000**. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss (UTC).
